  directory.

  Requirements for `answer.xyz`:
  - Include all explicit hydrogens.
  - Use a right-handed Cartesian coordinate system, units of angstroms.
  - Standard XYZ format: first line is the total atom count, second line a
    one-line comment, each remaining line `Element X Y Z`.

  When you are done, confirm that `answer.xyz` exists in the working directory.
  

[IMPORTANT CONSTRAINT] You must NOT call multiple tools in parallel. Execute tools ONE AT A TIME, sequentially. Wait for each tool's result before calling the next tool. Never batch multiple tool calls in a single response.

from rdkit.Chem import AllChem

# ---- heavy atoms (30) ----
# idx: (element, x_img, y_img, z)  z>0 = wedged (out of page), z<0 = dashed
heavy = [
 ('C', 415,165,  0),   # 0  C0 ring ketone
 ('O', 415, 55,  0),   # 1  ketone O

 ('O', 150,380, -1),   # 5  hydroxyl O (dashed)
 ('C', 422,403,  0),   # 6  ketal C
 ('C', 330,512, -1),   # 7  Me on ketal C (dashed)
 ('O', 522,350,  0),   # 8  bridge O
 ('C', 522,226,  0),   # 9  V1 CH
 ('C', 627,285,  0),   # 10 V2 CH
 ('C', 730,232, -1),   # 11 Me on V2 (dashed)
 ('C', 627,405,  0),   # 12 V3 CH
 ('O', 525,465,  0),   # 13 ketal ether O
 ('C', 732,462,  0),   # 14 chain CH(Me)
 ('C', 835,422, -1),   # 15 Me on chain CH (dashed)
 ('C', 734,584,  0),   # 16 =CH
 ('C', 836,642,  0),   # 17 =C(Me)
 ('C', 958,590,  0),   # 18 Me on alkene
 ('C', 836,762,  0),   # 19 =CH
 ('C', 940,824,  0),   # 20 =CH
 ('C', 939,944,  0),   # 21 C(OH)=
 ('O', 855,993,  0),   # 22 enol OH
 ('C', 1045,989, 0),   # 23 tetramic sp2 C
 ('C', 1045,1125,0),   # 24 tetramic C=O
 ('O', 941,1194, 0),   # 25 carbonyl O
 ('C', 1159,1162,0),   # 26 CH2
 ('N', 1250,1070,0),   # 27 NH
 ('C', 1150,966, 0),   # 28 tetramic C=O
 ('O', 1193,857, 0),   # 29 carbonyl O
]
# explicit stereocenter H's: (attached idx, x_img, y_img, z)
stereoH = [
 (2,  315,120, -1),   # H on epoxide CH (behind, epoxide O in front)
 (9,  585,135, -1),   # H on V1 (dashed)
 (10, 640,270, +1),   # H on V2 (front; Me dashed)
 (12, 628,500, -1),   # H on V3 (dashed)
 (14, 732,430, +1),   # H on chain CH (front; Me dashed)
]
bonds = [
 (0,1,'D'),(0,2,'S'),(0,9,'S'),
 (2,3,'S'),(2,4,'S'),(3,4,'S'),(3,5,'S'),(3,6,'S'),
 (6,7,'S'),(6,8,'S'),(6,13,'S'),
 (8,9,'S'),
 (9,10,'S'),(10,11,'S'),(10,12,'S'),
 (12,13,'S'),(12,14,'S'),
 (14,15,'S'),(14,16,'S'),
 (16,17,'D'),(17,18,'S'),(17,19,'S'),
 (19,20,'D'),(20,21,'S'),
 (21,22,'S'),(21,23,'D'),
 (23,24,'S'),(23,28,'S'),
 (24,25,'D'),(24,26,'S'),
 (26,27,'S'),(27,28,'S'),(28,29,'D'),
]

rw = Chem.RWMol()
for el,x,y,z in heavy:
    rw.AddAtom(Chem.Atom(el))
for a,b,t in bonds:
    bt = Chem.BondType.DOUBLE if t=='D' else Chem.BondType.SINGLE
    rw.AddBond(a,b,bt)
for h in stereoH:
    hi = rw.AddAtom(Chem.Atom('H'))
    rw.AddBond(h[0], hi, Chem.BondType.SINGLE)

mol = rw.GetMol()
conf = Chem.Conformer(mol.GetNumAtoms())
for i,(el,x,y,z) in enumerate(heavy):
    conf.SetAtomPosition(i, (float(x), float(-y), float(z)*95.0))  # flip y -> right-handed Cartesian
for j,(ai,x,y,z) in enumerate(stereoH):
    conf.SetAtomPosition(len(heavy)+j, (float(x), float(-y), float(z)*95.0))
mol.AddConformer(conf)

Chem.SanitizeMol(mol)
Chem.AssignStereochemistryFrom3D(mol, confId=0, replaceExistingTags=True)

smi = Chem.MolToSmiles(mol, isomericSmiles=True)
print('isomeric SMILES:', smi)
print('chiral centers (idx, CIP):', Chem.FindMolChiralCenters(mol, includeCIP=True, useLegacyImplementation=False))
for b in mol.GetBonds():
    if b.GetBondType()==Chem.BondType.DOUBLE:
        print('double bond', b.GetBeginAtomIdx(), b.GetEndAtomIdx(), 'stereo:', b.GetStereo())

# save the stereo SMILES for next step
with open('stereo.smi','w') as f:
    f.write(smi)

from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem

smi = open('stereo.smi').read().strip()
mol = Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi)
mol = Chem.AddHs(mol)
print('atoms:', mol.GetNumAtoms())  # expect 55

params = AllChem.ETKDGv3()
params.randomSeed = 0xC0FFEE
ok = AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mol, params)
print('embed status:', ok)
mp = AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(mol, mmffVariant='MMFF94s')
res = AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(mol, mmffVariant='MMFF94s', maxIters=3000)
print('MMFF status:', res)

# verify stereo preserved
Chem.AssignStereochemistryFrom3D(mol)
smi2 = Chem.MolToSmiles(Chem.RemoveHs(mol), isomericSmiles=True)
print('stereo preserved:', smi2 == smi)
print('centers:', Chem.FindMolChiralCenters(mol, includeCIP=True, useLegacyImplementation=False))

Chem.MolToXYZFile(mol, 'pre_xtb.xyz')
print('wrote pre_xtb.xyz')
EOF
